title: INT8 weight-only verification horizon and adaptive thresholds for GPTQ/AWQ integration
creator: Aisha N. Patel
description: Scope: Build an end-to-end verification harness that validates INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) quantization profiles against production-like workloads. The harness will run nightly and for canary rollouts, produce per-model and per-prompt-bucket fidelity metrics, and provide adaptive accept/reject thresholds that evolve with observed drift. Goals: (1) detect regressions that matter for downstream customers (golden-answer deltas, hallucination rate, task-specific accuracy); (2) reduce false positives by using sequence-length-aware baselines and grouping by prompt archetype; (3) automate fallback decisions (FP8/FP16 variants) when deployed profiles cross thresholds; (4) surface telemetry and diagnostics to console dashboards and PRs for fast triage. Out of scope: retraining or model surgery — this ticket focuses on verification, telemetry, and automated failover actions.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly job runs for the selected model cohort and publishes a per-model fidelity report in S3 and Console storage with a stable schema
Adaptive threshold algorithm implemented: thresholds update weekly based on the previous 30 days of golden-answer deltas and maintain configurable minimum sensitivity
Canary pipeline uses the harness to gate rollouts: if > 2 prompt-buckets for a model exceed the threshold, canary fails and automatic rollback path to FP8/FP16 triggers
Telemetry keys (profile_id, model_variant, prompt_bucket, seq_len, delta_metric) emitted and visible in the Console trace for at least 7 days
comments: 2025-02-14 - Spike: ran 24h synthetic sweep comparing GPTQ vs AWQ for three mid-sized models. Observed that short-seq prompts (<64 tokens) had lower delta variance but long-seq prompts amplified small numeric differences. Recommendation: compute separate thresholds per seq_len bucket.

2025-02-18 - Design review with PM/QA: agreed to include golden-answer delta (BLEU/ROUGE-like task metric) + a simple perplexity delta as a secondary indicator. PM requested a lightweight per-customer severity flag to prioritize investigations.

2025-02-22 - Implementation note: opted to store calibration snapshots (FP32 logits + top-k tokens) for a representative subset of prompts to speed root-cause triage. Storage cost estimates attached in Confluence.
2025-02-25 - Eng review: telemetry schema v1 approved. PR #1423 (runtime) opened to add profile_id propagation through serving path. Waiting on runtime-1.20 branch merge.

2025-02-28 - Testing: added fuzzed adversarial prompts discovered two cases where AWQ produced token-insertion hallucinations for a niche prompt bucket. Created sub-issue ENG-430001 to capture mitigation research.
2025-03-01 - PM feedback: add a dashboard widget that shows canary ladder status and top failing buckets. Assigned to design for quick mockups (DES-2102).
